research_question: Can sparse cross-asset crash consensus preserve the useful stock-risk signal while avoiding continuous de-risking during ordinary equity stress?

lineage.riskcast_result: fixed static stock-risk overlay improved 2016-2022 Sharpe across 4/8/12% ATR costs; forecast-MSE health failed
lineage.policy_health_result: trailing policy-Sharpe health failed; no parameters from either failed gate are retuned here

stock_vote.interpretation: above the expert's causal rolling median after IQR normalization

crypto_fragility.market_return: equal-weight log return of contemporaneous liquid crypto universe

sizing.stock_risk_magnitude: median of four stock expert robust-unit scores
sizing.source: same frozen sizing law as RiskCast static policy

modes.stock_majority: stock majority activation without crypto confirmation
modes.stock_unanimous: all four stock experts must be above median
modes.crypto_only: full risk activation when crypto fragility alone is true
modes.cross_unanimous: all four stock experts above median AND crypto fragility
modes.inverted_cross: crypto fragility AND at most one stock expert above median; use calmness magnitude
modes.cross_majority: candidate: at least 3 of 4 stock experts above median AND crypto fragility

falsifiers: cross_majority must beat base at 4% ATR in both research_2016_2020 and dev_2021_2022
cross_majority must beat inverted_cross on pooled 2016-2022 selection Sharpe at 4% ATR
cross_majority should beat stock_majority for crypto confirmation to earn complexity
cross_majority should beat crypto_only for stock information to add incremental value
pooled 2016-2022 improvement must survive 8% and 12% ATR cost stress
no post-result vote threshold, momentum horizon, volatility horizon, floor, or rebalance rescue

constraints.data: Quantiacs-provided crypto and historical constituent stock data only
